Running command: python3 -c "
import struct

# WASM binary
wasm = bytearray()
wasm += b'\x00asm\x01\x00\x00\x00'  # header

# Elem section (id=9)
elem_section = bytearray()
elem_section += b'\x01'  # count: 1 segment
elem_section += b'\x00'  # flags: 0 (active)
elem_section += b'\xd0'  # ref.null opcode
elem_section += b'\x70'  # type: funcref
elem_section += b'\x0b'  # end opcode
elem_section += b'\x00'  # elem count: 0

wasm += b'\x09'  # elem section id
wasm += bytes([len(elem_section)])  # section size
wasm += elem_section

with open('/workspace/poc.wasm', 'wb') as f:
    f.write(bytes(wasm))

print('Wrote', len(wasm), 'bytes')
print(wasm.hex())
"
